https://docs.paynest.example/changelog.text:
# API changelog

Each release is a dated API version. Send it in the `Paynest-Version` header; requests without it use your account's default version.

## 2026-08-14 (latest)

- Refunds accept an optional `reason`.
- `GET /v1/payouts` supports `limit` up to 500.

## 2026-03-02

- New payouts API.
- Deprecated `charge.source`.

## 2025-11-20

- First public version.
